name: Introduction girl
source: A girl used by Professor Ivy in the VN's introduction as an example of how the Pokémon League's stripping rules work, and in a tutorial on hiding the dialogue box to see the art in full. Also appears in the Livestreamed Nudity ending, where she takes pictures of the naked rival.
